title: The Custard in the Blue Ramekin
youtube_title: The Custard in the Blue Ramekin | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Kito wants to check on a custard in a blue ramekin before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Kito leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
